world.parent: xcell-her (sprint 1); maintenance/turnover idea from lenia-multichannel mcfd-MIRd; 5-px mutation patches + neutral arm from active-droplets ad5
world.mutation: Arm S of the sprint-2 evolution experiment. xcell-her minus its unused hdep channel plus one membrane-gated waste q (tau=40, D=2, K=0.15; turnover). Turnover is IMPOSED: chemostat-style dilution erases a random disk (radius 5) at Poisson rate KILL_RATE, identically in every arm. No marker is planted: h-on kinds arise only from rare cell-scale h kicks (Poisson, rate 0.005 per time unit, Gaussian disk sigma 1.5, amplitude 2.5, anywhere in the box). Only bodies (+ v, w dress) are planted. Selection arm: an h-on cell adds W[c,h]=0.15 cargo production (cargo activates the body, so on-cells grow and refill space faster).

warnings: a channel total changed by more than 50% (not conserved; may be fine if the model is open)
